items.title: Roland Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: I have a young saxophonist by the name of Keytayake Aomori... We’re putting out another one on him.

ctx.x: That’s a great experience for them.

Yes it was. And one of the guitarists, he’s a wonderful guitarist, named Stan Young, a young fellow, he really is a young fellow, he’s 25, 26, something like that. And he was just, when he heard the record he couldn’t believe how good it sounded. But I’m still doing that and I’m planning to do more. We have one coming out on Jeb Patton. We plan to do another one, we’ve got one, I have a young saxophonist by the name of Keytayake Aomori. Now he’s the son of the young bass player that I have on this record now.…
